description: This file implements the login page component for a React application using Remix framework. It includes server-side loaders and actions for authentication, form handling, redirection, and session management. The component renders a login form, handles user input, displays error messages, and initiates login requests.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Checks for existing user session token; if present, redirects to /notes, else returns empty JSON.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles login form submission; verifies inputs, calls API for login, sets session token cookie, and redirects; handles errors.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React component rendering the login form, managing form state, error display, and submission feedback.
